description: This file provides a simple API client utility that uses fetch to make HTTP requests. It dynamically reads the base URL from an environment variable, constructs request URLs, and handles request headers including authorization tokens. It also processes responses, parsing JSON when appropriate and handling errors.

methods.name: getApiBaseUrl()
methods.description: Returns the configured API base URL from environment variable, without trailing slash.

methods.name: buildUrl(path)
methods.description: Constructs a full URL by combining the base URL with a given path, handling normalization.

methods.name: apiRequest(path, options = {})
methods.description: Performs an API request to the specified path with optional options, handling headers and parsing the response.
